Frequently asked questions

01Are the films free?

Yes. They are free with a MyTelevision account.

02Does the catalogue change?

Yes. New titles arrive with broadcasting agreements; some may also leave the catalogue.

03Are some films for adults only?

Some films contain violent scenes. Read each title’s page before playing it, especially if children are nearby.

04Can I finish a film later?

Yes. Playback resumes where you stopped, on the same account.

05Do I need an app?

No. Films play in your browser on a computer, tablet or phone. The iPhone and Android apps are also available.
